description: Why: operators rely on cmd_status to see how many peers are currently connected and active. What: cli/ops.rs cmd_status counts active peers with WHERE blacklisted_until IS NULL OR blacklisted_until = 0. The = 0 branch catches the default zero value but also catches any row where blacklisted_until was explicitly set to 0 (meaning 'not blacklisted') while excluding rows where blacklisted_until contains a past timestamp that is still non-zero. The correct condition is blacklisted_until IS NULL OR blacklisted_until <= now_ms. Active peer count is wrong for any peer that was previously blacklisted and has since been unblacklisted via the path that sets the column to NULL (vs. 0).
title: cmd_status active-peer count includes non-expired blacklists
